description: This file defines Express routes for managing application deployment records, including CRUD operations and a specialized endpoint for resolving project names based on project IDs. It incorporates caching for performance optimization and handles various payload shapes for project ID extraction.

methods.name: cacheGet
methods.description: Retrieves a cached project name for a given normalized project ID if the cache entry exists and is not expired.

methods.name: cacheSet
methods.description: Stores a project name in the cache with an expiration timestamp based on TTL.

methods.name: extractNormalizedProjectId
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes a project ID from various payload shapes, returning null if none found.
